name: FPS Monitor
description: Compact performance overlay for FPS, frame time, 1% lows, hitches, CPU/GPU usage & temps, render times, scene stats, JS memory, and resolution.

settings.label: Show frame time (ms)
settings.description: Shows average frame time and worst spike (max ms) over the last second.

settings.label: Show 1% low FPS
settings.description: Shows the 1% low FPS over a rolling 10-second window to highlight micro-stutters.

settings.label: Show frame hitches (50ms+)
settings.description: Counts frames taking 50ms or longer in the last 10 seconds (plus JS long tasks when supported).

settings.label: Show CPU usage & temp
settings.description: Shows system CPU % (or app CPU %) and package temperature via Terra native telemetry.

settings.label: Show GPU usage & temp
settings.description: Shows GPU utilization % and temperature (or Android thermal status & battery temp).

settings.label: Show CPU/GPU render time (ms)
settings.description: Hooks Biketerra's 3D engine to show JS render() CPU time and WebGPU queue completion time.

settings.label: Show draws, triangles & VRAM
settings.description: Shows live 3D draw calls, triangle count, and engine GPU buffer/texture memory.

settings.label: Show JS heap memory (MB)
settings.description: Shows live JS heap usage on Chromium/Electron (hidden automatically if unavailable).

settings.label: Show canvas resolution
settings.description: Shows the active 3D canvas pixel dimensions (width x height).
